text:
sophie: quick callout 11 exploring two layouts for the Usage & Billing page: a persistent left rail (scope + token breakdown) vs stacked section cards. which feels clearer for org-level customers?
jamal: left rail for desktop. keeps the timeline/charts centered. easier to pin filters too.
kevin: agree for desktop, but left rail squeezes content on narrower windows. stacked cards scale more gracefully.
lina: mobile-first thought 1 stacked cards with a sticky header + quick scope chip would be easiest for phone users.
maria: accessibility reminder 1 left rail must include a skip link and logical tab order. also add aria-region labeling.
sophie: what about the scope control copy? current "Switch scope" is vague. propose explicit tabs: "Account | Project" so it's crystal. default to Account for org admins.
jamal: explicit tabs = less guessing. also show a small org badge when switching to Account so people know the scope.
kevin: token breakdown discovery is key. if using stacked cards, make the breakdown expand/collapse affordance obvious (chevrons + animation). if left rail, ensure keyboard focus lands there first when toggled.
maria: color note: token colors (soft blues/purples/greens) fail contrast at 12px labels. add 2px borders or pattern fills for colorblind users.
lina: pattern + color is great. can we include an optional legend toggle for high-contrast mode?
kevin: keyboard interactions: Tab should move into rail/cards; Enter toggles details; Space/Enter should activate download menu; Esc closes. aria-expanded and aria-controls required on toggles.
sophie: invoice CTA copy: lots of customers expect PDF. Maybe primary "Download invoice" opens quick choices: PDF, CSV, Line items. labeling: "Download invoice 026-03 (PDF)" for clarity.
jamal: analytics: track which format users pick and time-to-download so we can surface the most popular default.
maria: invoice modal accessibility: trap focus, provide heading "Invoice 026-03 1 Redwood Inference" and include aria-describedby for the download options. keyboard order must be logical (formats first, then close).
kevin: microcopy tweak for cost breakdown: replace "tokens" with "compute tokens" in some places to reduce confusion with auth tokens. tiny win.
lina: animation nit: collapse/expand should be 180ms ease-out and have reduced-motion fallback.
sophie: design-bot uploaded frames: https://figma.com/file/uniquefile456 1 has rail + stacked + mobile accordion.
design-bot: Note added: focusable skip link, aria roles, CTA menu pattern, high-contrast legend.
sophie: final asks: kevin 1 prototype keyboard/focus + reduced-motion; jamal 1 analytics events + scope badge; maria 1 high-contrast tokens + modal ARIA copy; lina 1 mobile sticky header + accordion behavior. 15min sync tomorrow after prototypes?
kevin: works for me 1 will push a clickable prototype by EOD.
jamal: I'll wire up event names and sample payloads.
maria: prepping ARIA snippets and color swatches now.
lina: will mock mobile states and include reduced-motion versions.
sophie: thanks all 1 I'll send calendar invite and attach the Figma link here after updates. :sparkles:
